notes.title: Update - Sept. 13 2017 & Valcarta II: Domination News!
notes.content:
Valcarta: Rise of the Demon has been updated!

I have changed the script that was handling the handshake with the Steam API to flag achievements.
While this hasn't officially been tested, it is my hope that those users out there that were having problems previously, no longer end up with said problem whilst playing.

Again, this fix has not been tested, so your feedback is welcome.
The first achievement occurs at the end of the tutorial where you pick a path. If you are in Offline Mode, you will not receive an Achievement (please keep this in mind)
Any further feedback regarding the games achievements should be posted on the forums! Thanks in advance!

On another note, Valcarta II: Domination (Dark Path Sequel) will be hitting Alpha soon! I will be releasing information about that soon on Valcarta's facebook page (linked below) with screenshots and more information over the next couple of weeks!
